display_description: Repair Authlib JOSE key provenance across JWS and JWE and emit a regression report.
problem_statement:
# Repair JOSE key provenance

You are working in a frozen Authlib source tree under `/app/vendor/authlib`.
An application accepts JWS and JWE messages that may contain a `jwk` header.
Treat that header as untrusted metadata: it must never become the verification
or decryption key merely because the caller omitted a key.

Repair the existing implementation, not just the report script. Trace the
compact and JSON deserialization paths into the algorithm key-preparation code
and make the same trust-boundary rule hold for both JWS and JWE. Preserve the
existing algorithm allow-listing, explicit key handling, and callable key
resolver behavior. Do not reject a message merely because it has a `jwk`
header when the caller explicitly supplies the trusted key.

After editing the source modules, run:

```sh
python3 /app/run_repair_check.py
```

The command must write `/app/output.json` using schema version
`jose-trust-report.v1`. It must report successful explicit JWS, explicit JWE,
and callback verification, while both omitted-key cases are rejected. Keep the
vendored package and its existing tests intact; do not install dependencies or
use the network.
